text:
Ivy: Quick thread to finalize the pilot gating matrix for the Optimize Toolkit with customer Zephyr. Need clear pass/fail for batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts before kickoff.
Marcus: Proposed pass criteria:
- econ: projected cost reduction >= 15% on matched traffic sample
- quality: task_concordance >= 98% vs baseline and hallucination_rate increase <= 1.0% absolute
- latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 360ms for tail-safe route
Hannah: Concordance check: run sampling of 1000 paired outputs across configs and require >=98% token-level match OR human accept <=1% change. Add golden-set (300 prompts) gating: fail if >1.5% regression.
Devon: Eval-alert config draft:
```
alert_config:
  primary_metric: "task_concordance"
  baseline: 0.985
  alert_if_drop_abs: 0.01
  window_minutes: 30
  min_samples: 80
  embedding_drift_warn: 0.02
```
Devon: Also add an "alignment" sentinel check for hallucination: run a hallucination classifier on sampled outputs; alert if sustained >1.0% increase over 1h.
Marcus: On batching: two pilot cohorts
- tail-safe: max_batch_delay=6ms (aim p95)
- econ-first: max_batch_delay=30ms (maximize throughput)
Ivy: We'll also run a shadow traffic experiment (100% shadow to baseline for 72h) to compute projected cost and concordance before enabling real traffic.
Hannah: Caching policy: prefix cache only on endpoints in whitelist, TTL <= 30m during pilot. Target cache_hit >= 25% where enabled. CS must provide whitelist and confirm no PII.
QA-bot: golden_set_upload required -> waiting for Zephyr (status: pending) :hourglass: 
Devon: Rollback rules: auto-rollback to baseline if any primary alert fires twice in 12h OR golden-set fails. Manual pause if embedding drift warns. Runbook will include traffic flip + disable cache + disable batching flag.
Ivy: Telemetry schema: per-route experiment_id, tokens, cost_estimate, cache_hits, batch_delay_ms_histogram, latency_buckets, task_concordance, hallucination_rate, sample_ids for manual review.
Marcus: Decision summary:
- Run shadow 72h then two canaries (tail-safe + econ-first). 
- Pilot pass if econ >=15% AND concordance >=98% AND no primary alerts for 48h.
- Auto-rollback on two alerts in 12h or golden-set failure.
Action items: @Devon (PR eval config + runbook), @Hannah (concordance runner + golden set), @Marcus (cost projection + experiment tags), @Ivy (pilot doc + CS checklist). 
deploy-bot: deploy queued -> pilot/zephyr/1789991010 (status: scheduled) :rocket:
Ivy: I'll send this to Zephyr with the checklist. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
